description: A brass laboratory microscope with a dark body stands on a wooden desk in a dim room, lit by a lamp at upper left. Beside it are small wooden boxes, a dropper bottle, and glass slides laid in a row, plus a handwritten paper at lower left. A bright circular inset above shows a field of pink and blue stained cells, with one darker purple cluster of misshapen cells at its centre. The style is an oil painting, edge to edge, with no frame.
